text:
ANTIFRAUD::result
Description
This command returns result of login validation (passed or failed.)
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
result
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_LOGIN
{
log
local0.
"Username tried to log in with result [ANTIFRAUD::result]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_LOGIN
